name: scroll-text-marquee-unidirectional
title: Unidirectional Marquee
blurb: Text scrolls horizontally in one direction continuously.
description: Single-direction marquee loop, typical for tickers or flowing announcements.
use_when: News, announcements, or atmospheric repeating text.
avoid_when: Important static content — marquee speed makes it glanceable but not readable.
a11y: Text scrolls continuously with no pause. Screen readers see the loop.
